perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

enhanced.name: Rimestealer
enhanced.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

enhanced.name: Archer's Tempo
enhanced.description: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

enhanced.name: Impromptu Ammunition
enhanced.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a slightly increased duration.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Perfect Float
enhanced.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne accuracy and reduces flinch until you are out of combat for an extended duration.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.description: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Headstone
enhanced.description: Precision final blows spawn a large Stasis crystal at a target's location.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.

enhanced.name: Explosive Head
enhanced.description: Arrows explode after a short delay. Increases accuracy.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Archer's Gambit
enhanced.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

enhanced.name: Firefly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows with this weapon substantially increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby targets.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
enhanced.description: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.
